A = [0] * 21

    B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1
A[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10

best = float('inf')

def try_combinations(pos, current, cost):
    global best
    if cost >= best:
        return
    if pos == 0:
        if current == 0:
            best = cost
        return
    t = current // A[pos]
    neg_delta = abs(t) - 1
    if t < 0:
        neg_delta = -neg_delta
    pos_delta = abs(t) + 1
    if t < 0:
        pos_delta = -pos_delta

    try_combinations(pos - 1, current - t * B[pos], cost + abs(t) * pos)
    try_combinations(pos - 1, current - neg_delta * B[pos], cost + abs(neg_delta) * pos)
    try_combinations(pos - 1, current - pos_delta * B[pos], cost + abs(pos_delta) * pos)

try_combinations(digit_count, n, 0)
try_combinations(digit_count, B[digit_count + 1] - n, digit_count + 1)

print(best)
